title: Floer cohomology and higher mutations
note: PDF library/arxiv-2301.08311v4/2301.08311v4.pdf — arXiv:2301.08311v4 [math.SG], stamped 17 Sep 2024; id year is the arXiv submission. One idea taken: Floer cohomology is invariant under local mutation *up to a change of local systems* — the object is not invariant, it is invariant after twisting, which is the shape of `QOU.DqTwist.dq_eq_twist_comp`. The technical core (SFT compactness, moduli of broken maps) is not importable.
